Verified mechanistic code exists; a pinned raw FSCV dataset, independent concentration labels and standard test split/scorer were not established here. Could support explicitly synthetic parameter-recovery research later.

Open PNS/organ physiology data clearly exists, but portal-level inclusion is not an executable endpoint. Select a specific licensed dataset with known intervention/input and outcome, then define protocol before admitting it.

Useful 62-pair animal-audio denoising task, but record limits use to educational/noncommercial purposes and mixture provenance must be reviewed. Audio denoising is lower priority than lab-specific caller attribution and segmentation.

Phenotypes an LLM acting as an experimental subject across seven psychology experiments. This differs from analyzing neural data or recovering human cognitive parameters. It is useful prior art for multilevel model-family comparisons.
